_comment: CONTRIBUTING (for future agents / the Overseer): this file feeds the 'What's new' welcome panel (src/ui/WhatsNew.ts). When you merge a feature a player would actually notice, append ONE entry to the front of `entries` (highest id, newest first) — do not edit or remove old entries, they are history for a returning player who missed a while. Bump `id` by 1 from the current highest. Keep the voice kid-friendly (Eleri is 6): short, one line, plain words, exclamation marks welcome, emoji that matches the thing. Schema per entry: { id: number, emoji: string, title: string, line: string }.

entries.title: A Tidier Screen
entries.line: All the buttons at the top now hide behind one Menu button, so you can see more of the park!

entries.title: The Lift Has Buttons!
entries.line: Stand by the glass lift and a proper lift panel pops up — press the big button, hop in, then press the floor you want!

entries.title: One-Press Collecting!
entries.line: Every thing in a shop now has its own big Collect button — press it once and it is yours!

entries.title: Make Your Own Character!
entries.line: Pick your name, hair, clothes, a hat and a starting pet before you hop off the bus!

entries.title: Rail Racer!
entries.line: Find the stripy stall and race — hold to go fast, let go to duck!

entries.title: Your Parade & Cute-o-dex
entries.line: Cute things you find follow you in a parade or peek out of your backpack — collect them all in your Cute-o-dex!

entries.title: 900 Balls In The Ball Pit!
entries.line: The ball pit at the bottom of the ginormous slide got WAY more balls — they shove, pile up and scatter properly when you land!

entries.title: Other Kids To Meet
entries.line: The park is full of other children riding rides, shopping and having fun — say hello!

entries.title: Extra Cute Cartoon Look
entries.line: Everyone got bigger, cuter heads, the camera came in close, and a rainbow pops out whenever you hop!

entries.title: Seven Shops To Explore!
entries.line: Collect toys, balloons, candy floss, ice cream, hats, stickers and surprise eggs — take as many as you like!

entries.title: Play On Your Phone
entries.line: Tap where you want to walk, tap things to use them, and add the game to your home screen to play full-screen!

entries.title: The Castle & Ginormous Slide
entries.line: Ride the glass lift, escalators or stairs up the castle — then whoosh down the GINORMOUS slide into the ball pit!

entries.title: Welcome To The Garden Park
entries.line: Explore a big garden full of trees, bushes, paths and a wishing fountain — toss in a coin and see what happens!
